cases.question: Rank customers by their completed revenue.

cases.question: Show every product and its price difference from the prior product by price.

cases.question: For each region, rank representatives by their order count.
reference_sql_variants: SELECT r.name AS region, sr.name AS representative, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC) AS region_rank FROM regions r JOIN sales_representatives sr ON sr.region_id = r.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name, sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY r.name, region_rank, sr.name
